target: acceptance 6 — a case that ran and failed is exit 1, distinct from nothing-ran
cmd:
mkdir -p c
mkdir -p c/failing
cat > c/failing/f-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "f-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "exit 9", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite failing >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{"code":%s}' $?
